correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the synchronous open-neighbor update on K_a join I_b. Monochromaticity of the six original colour classes is exact: while a class remains at its current colour it contributes zero to its own successor count; clipping each original class size at 2 preserves every at-least-two predicate after every transition. The finite quotient has precisely 3^6=729 clipped mass patterns. Independently enumerated all 729 at exact integer arithmetic and obtained F^7=F^4 on every nonempty class, 122 three-cycle-attracted patterns, 31 distinct EGF monomials and sharp first entry 4. Direct labelled small-graph dynamics and exact coefficient calculations corroborate. Symbolic coefficient weights 1,z,U and 1,w,V give Phi=U^3 exp(3w)+3U^2 exp(2w)[V+z(V+w)]+3V^3(z+z^2)+z^3(V+w)^3; coefficient extraction yields all labelled basins. The fixed-a Dirichlet-style occupancy union bound for three large independent-class occupancies gives the claimed p_a and uniform error. Boundaries a,b>=1 and explicit G_(2,5) sharpness respected; all-a,b proof relies on quotient exactness, not extrapolation from 752877 labelled finite states.
